_comment: The only list of PrismRT dependency versions. CI, the build scripts, CMake and the docs-drift test read it. See 'How to upgrade a dependency' in docs/deployment.md.

oidn._comment: Built from source against onetbb: on Windows with the CPU device only (tools/ci/build_oidn.ps1), on macOS with the CPU and Metal devices (tools/ci/build_oidn_macos.sh; docs/DECISIONS.md). ispc_sha256 is the Windows ISPC zip, ispc_macos_sha256 the macOS universal tarball.

vk_oidn._comment: Vulkan denoiser (OIDN 2.5.1 weights): the prebuilt SDK package and the commit of its tag, for pack_weights.py (tools/ci/fetch_vk_oidn.ps1; docs/DECISIONS.md).

nanobind._comment: Python bindings (python/, docs/python.md): pip install --no-deps --target <prefix> nanobind==<version>, then nanobind_DIR=<prefix>/nanobind/cmake. The wheel carries robin_map. vcpkg's port of the same version builds its own CPython, so it is not used.
